These radiator flaps will need to be low cost and will utilize two-phase equipment to efficiently transport heat from the main radiator to theflaps. This activity will assess the use of flexible heat pipes or low-cost loop heat pipes. Several technologies will be evaluatedand the one that offers the best flexibility and scalability for high aspect ratio satellites will be selected. The assembly of the2-phase equipment with the flap will also have to be studied, as well as the flap technology itself (material, coating) to meet mass, performance and integration requirements (stowed and deployed configuration). This activity encompasses the following tasks: - Requirements consolidation. - Technologies trade off review and baseline selection. - Design and manufacturing of a breadboard demonstrator. - Validation testing of the breadboard demonstrator.Procurement Policy: C(2) = Activities in open competition, where a significant participation of non-LSI is requested.
